Overview

About the Role

As the Principal Technical Product Manager for the AI Health Cloud, you will define and lead the strategy, architecture, and delivery of AI-powered healthcare platforms and analytics experiences.

With 15+ years of experience driving complex technical products and enterprise-scale programs, you will shape platform capabilities, influence architectural direction, and drive high-impact execution across engineering, AI/ML, data, clinical, pharmacy, and provider teams.

Your leadership will accelerate AI adoption across payer, provider, and pharmacy workflows, improving quality, compliance, clinical performance, and operational efficiency.

Responsibilities

Product Strategy & Vision
· Define and evangelize the multi-year product vision for AI-driven healthcare analytics, workflow automation, and decision support across payer, provider, and pharmacy domains.
· Develop strategic roadmaps aligned with enterprise priorities, CMS/NCQA requirements, and multi-stakeholder needs.
· Identify emerging opportunities in generative AI, LLMs, agent-based systems, and workflow orchestration.

Technical Leadership
· Provide senior-level technical direction for engineering, AI/ML, and architecture teams in building scalable cloud-native AI platforms.
· Lead strategies for integrating multi-source healthcare data from providers (EHR/EMR, clinical documentation, FHIR), payers (claims, eligibility), and pharmacy systems (Rx claims, medication histories, formulary data).
· Influence platform decisions around Azure cloud infrastructure, performance, scalability, and Responsible AI standards.

Requirements, Execution & Delivery
· Own end-to-end product requirements across clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, provider processes, AI/ML use cases, and regulatory domains.
· Translate complex user needs into detailed user stories, specifications, and acceptance criteria.
· Drive Agile execution at scale, ensuring high-quality delivery and predictable roadmap progression.

Quality, Compliance & Responsible AI
· Ensure product capabilities comply with CMS, NCQA, HIPAA, and internal Responsible AI policies.
· Partner with compliance, clinical, and pharmacy leaders to support audit readiness, regulatory initiatives, and model governance.
· Track emerging federal and state regulatory changes affecting provider, pharmacy, and payer workflows.

AI Insights, Analytics & Value Realization
· Champion the development of AI-driven insights, predictive analytics, care coordination recommendations, utilization insights, pharmacy adherence models, and workflow automation features.
· Ensure outputs are explainable, actionable, and embedded into provider, pharmacy, and payer workflows.
· Drive customer adoption and measurable business/clinical outcomes.

Stakeholder & Partner Leadership
· Serve as the principal product owner and primary liaison for engineering, clinical, pharmacy, and external provider partners.
· Lead customer advisory boards and strategic partner engagements across payer, provider, and pharmacy sectors.
· Build trusted relationships with executives and operational leaders.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications
· 15+ years in technical product management, AI/ML platforms, cloud data products, or large-scale healthcare technology initiatives.
· Strong experience with provider, pharmacy, and payer domains; familiarity with clinical, operational, or pharmacy workflows.
· Expertise in healthcare data standards including HL7, FHIR, C-CDA, claims data, medication data formats, and pharmacy system integrations.
· Proven success influencing cross-functional teams to deliver enterprise-grade AI or platform solutions.
· Exceptional communication skills and ability to influence executive stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications
· Experience with Azure, AI/ML tooling, and modern MLOps frameworks.
· Knowledge of LLMs, model evaluation, agent frameworks, and AI governance.
· Experience with provider analytics, pharmacy performance programs, Stars/HEDIS measures, and care management workflows.
· Familiarity with BI and analytics tools (Power BI, Databricks AI/BI).

Success Metrics
· AI capability adoption across provider, payer, and pharmacy workflows.
· Clear ROI and measurable improvements in quality, operations, clinical performance, or pharmacy outcomes.
· High platform reliability, scalability, and user satisfaction.
· Predictable, high-quality product delivery and roadmap execution.

About our Line of Business

BrightSpring Health Services provides complementary home- and community-based health solutions for complex populations in need of specialized and/or chronic care. Through the Company’s service lines, including pharmacy, home health care, and rehabilitation, we provide comprehensive and more integrated care and clinical solutions in all 50 states to over 475,000 customers, clients and patients daily. BrightSpring has consistently demonstrated strong and industry-leading quality metrics across its services lines, while improving the health and quality of life for high-need individuals and reducing overall healthcare system costs. For more information, please visit www.brightspringhealth.com . Follow us on Facebook , LinkedIn , and X .

Additional Job Information

Why Join Us?
· Lead strategy for a next-generation AI Health Cloud platform transforming healthcare delivery.
· Collaborate with engineers, clinicians, pharmacists, and AI innovators solving high-impact problems.
· Competitive compensation and benefits designed for senior technology leaders.
· Work in a flexible, innovative environment driven by collaboration, creativity, and continuous learning.

Overview

We are seeking a visionary and execution-driven Vice President of Product Strategy & Execution, AI Health Cloud to lead the strategic direction and delivery of both platform capabilities and AI-powered healthcare solutions within our next-generation AI-enabled Health Cloud Platform.

This role is ideal for a product leader who thrives at the intersection of AI innovation, platform thinking, and solution delivery, with a strong background in clinical and pharmacy domains. You will be responsible for defining product strategy, gathering and refining requirements, re-engineering processes, prioritizing initiatives, and driving execution against a published roadmap to deliver measurable outcomes.

Responsibilities

- Build and lead a high-performing team of Global Process / Product Owners and Technical Program Managers, fostering a culture of ownership, agility, and accountability.
- Define and own the AI/ML product strategy and roadmap across platform and solution domains, ensuring alignment with business goals and clinical needs.
- Lead requirements gathering from internal stakeholders, end users, and external partners to inform product direction.
- Drive global process re-engineering to streamline workflows and optimize delivery of AI-powered healthcare solutions.
- Prioritize product initiatives based on impact, feasibility, and strategic alignment, balancing short-term wins with long-term platform evolution.
- Oversee execution of the product roadmap, ensuring delivery to published milestones with high quality and stakeholder alignment.
- Collaborate with engineering, architecture, and data science teams to ensure platform capabilities support solution needs and scale effectively.
- Guide the integration of Generative AI, Agentic AI, RPA, and RAG-based systems into real-world healthcare workflows.
- Establish and manage KPIs, OKRs, and product performance metrics to track progress and drive continuous improvement.
- Stay ahead of emerging AI trends and assess their applicability to healthcare innovation.

Qualifications

- 15+ years of experience in program management, process innovation and product leadership including developing product operating model.
- MBA, MS, or PhD in a relevant field (e.g., Product Management, Computer Science, AI/ML, Health Informatics) preferred.
- Proven success delivering healthcare or pharmacy products in a regulated environment.
- Experience managing platform product build (e.g., APIs, services, developer tools) and solution delivery (e.g., clinical workflows, pharmacy automation).
- Experience working with cloud-native platforms, DevOps pipelines, and cross functional agile teams.
- Experience with multi-agent systems, RPA tools, and intelligent automation in healthcare.
- Exceptional skills in stakeholder engagement, strategic planning, and cross functional leadership.
- Strong grasp of healthcare data standards (FHIR, HL7, RxNorm, SNOMED CT) and compliance frameworks (HIPAA, HITRUST).
- Deep understanding of LLMs, RAG architectures, vector databases, and agentic AI frameworks (e.g., LangChain, AutoGen).
- Familiarity with responsible AI practices, model explainability, and human centered product development.
- Travel up to 25%
